title: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Subsequences
goal: Maximize the product of lengths of two disjoint palindromic subsequences.
strategy: Enumerate palindromic index masks. Subset DP stores the best palindrome available inside any mask, so each palindrome can pair with the best one entirely inside its complement.
